text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position in first paragraph and repeated conclusion","quality":"thesis consistency","description":"It states a clear claim early and keeps that position steady throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"uses article details about skids, rollovers, and seat vibration","quality":"textual support","description":"It grounds its argument in specific evidence from the source rather than mostly general claims."},{"evidence":"explains how sensors can brake and reduce engine power","quality":"explanatory development","description":"It does more than mention evidence by showing how the examples support the claim that driverless cars improve safety."},{"evidence":"organized into introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"structural organization","description":"It follows a more complete essay structure with clearer progression from claim to support to wrap-up."},{"evidence":"connects driverless features to preventing fatigue and weather-related accidents","quality":"reasoned analysis","description":"It links details from the article to realistic driving problems in a way that strengthens the argument."}]}
